contract.errorCodes: the published eleven; this release adds none

adapters.generic-cli: argv from the recipe's own invocation, programs resolved against the install dir or config.tools, never PATH
adapters.mcp-proxy: native MCP transport; mcp-sse performs a bounded same-origin SSE session and JSON-RPC initialize/tools/list/tools/call
adapters.http-adapter: POST to the recipe's declared endpoint
adapters.desktop-session: open/status/close; a human step answers INTERACTIVE_REQUIRED instead of a simulated success

attestation.means: declared + snapshot frozen + body present with the recipe's own digest; it does NOT claim the body advertised the capability

concurrency.pooled: one slot per digest(holder) mod poolSize
concurrency.exclusiveResources: one lock per key, loser writes nothing
concurrency.sessions: one held lock per session key until close
concurrency.scope: platform-internal (BP-4 1.3: cross-platform arbitration is not required and not claimed)

credentialModel.where: a platform-declared provider command (config.credentialProvider) hands over one reference; the connector writes it into a mode-0600 file and deletes it in the same call
credentialModel.shape: the release declares `credentialInjection` in connector.json: format, section, key names and the argv slots that reference the file - no client's flag spelling lives in shared code
credentialModel.never: the value is not placed in argv, in evidence, in the call index, or in the artifact scan, and a refusal after materialization still deletes the file

refusalRedaction: a refusal never quotes a caller-supplied string: the credential-literal case reports length and position, a schema violation reports rule and JSON pointer, and a provider failure reports its exit code with the error stream withheld

sessionLifecycle.open: boundary check first, then a platform launch provider answers for starting it; the pid is kept in the session record
sessionLifecycle.status: liveness is asked of the platform, so a window closed by hand reads back as SESSION_CLOSED instead of a stale READY
sessionLifecycle.close: terminate through the platform provider; a session that could not be stopped keeps its lock
sessionLifecycle.whenAbsent: INTERACTIVE_REQUIRED, with the reason naming the missing consent or the missing provider - never a simulated success

envelopeTolerance: `kind` may be absent on an inbound request: wf-runner 0.10.1 builds its gateway messages without it (engine.py:643, :727) although the published request shapes require it. Absent means request; a wrong value is still refused, and every other envelope rule is unchanged (D-93, same family as D-86).
